'''T'boor''' was a senior [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who was enrolled in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
Brought to the Temple at a young age, T'boor was selected by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Soon after the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Battle of Kothlis]], T'boor joined a fellow Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as part of Green team in a competition arranged by Master [[Taria Damsin]]. The competition, taking place in the new [[Sublevel nineteen training dojo|Sublevel Nineteen Training Dojo]], ended in a tie. Sadly T'boor fell in battle against modified [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s as the Green team crossed the dojo's river.
